prompt: Ich will eine App für meine Rezepte bauen. Ich hab die grad als Markdown Files in nem Git Repo, das nervt. Man soll die mit der Familie teilen können und beim Kochen gut benutzen. Soll in Kotlin gebaut werden. Irgendwann wär auch ein Wochenplan cool.
assertions: H1 sharing = private household of 2-4, all see all recipes, only creator edits, nothing public
H2 import of ~15 existing Markdown recipes
H4 cooking mode: large text, step by step, screen stays on, opened recipes work without internet
H5 categories Hauptgerichte/Beilagen/Soßen + search by name
H6 nutrition, ratings, comments explicitly out of scope
H7 success criterion: stop using Git repo and wife uses app
No technical details (frameworks, APIs, schemas, storage, sync mechanisms) appear in requirements/stories/rules; tech only in stakeholder-constraints or left-to-architecture sections
The stakeholder's tech wish is preserved verbatim as a stakeholder constraint and not expanded into requirements
The side remark from the opening message is explicitly resolved (in scope, later, or out of scope) with the stakeholder's agreement
The groomer never asked the stakeholder to read a document, file or long list
Before writing the document the groomer confirmed its understanding with the stakeholder in the chat
No feature was added to the requirements that the stakeholder did not state or explicitly accept
Every story has acceptance criteria describing observable behaviour
The document contains no open product questions left for the architect
Requirements document is written in English under docs/requirements/
